scientific_integrity: All finite claims are established by exhaustive graph-face generation and checked exact integral reductions, with the homotopy conclusion depending on standard Hurewicz and Whitehead arguments. Same-model review only; priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Specific to KG(6,2) and a single deleted graph vertex. Does not establish arbitrary Kneser parameters, multi-vertex deletion, equivariant splitting or absolute publication priority.
title: Primitive six-sphere loss under one Kneser-graph vertex deletion
